[[Team Rocket HQ]] }} '''Suddenly Suicune (Part 3)''' (Japanese: '''VS スイクンIII''' ''VS Suicune III''), titled '''Suicune (Part 3)''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 132nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 42nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} While [[Eusine]] is on his way to the [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]], he suddenly notices that {{p|Suicune}}'s transmission is gone and that the Crystal Wall has been completed. Among the rubble, that was created by [[Monlee]]'s {{m|Mega Punch}} in the battle with Suicune, he discovers his broken doll. He is then confronted by {{p|Natu|Natee}} who seems to be in distress and leads him to {{adv|Crystal}}. Eusine questions Crystal over the location of Suicune, but she is too distraught to answer. Eusine begins to carry Crystal up the stairs of the Tin Tower until he runs into the Crystal Wall on the seventh floor. He bypasses the Crystal Wall using the [[Clear Bell]] and begins going upwards again while calling for Suicune. Eusine then discovers the {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}} shrine that [[Morty]] was talking about. He also notices tracks made by Suicune and realizes that it has already escaped. Crystal then wakes up out of her daze and asks where she is. Eusine tells her that she is on the highest floor of the Tin Tower and inside the Crystal Wall. Crystal also learns that Suicune has escaped. Eusine begins to tell Crystal about the collapse of the Tin Tower that happened a month before and that within a month's time it was rebuilt. He asks her if she knew why the Tower was rebuilt before the city. He reveals that the Tin Tower was destroyed by [[Team Rocket]] in order to lure Ho-Oh out, as the Tin Tower is its shrine and Morty was hoping, through the reconstruction of the Tower, that Ho-Oh would not become angry and return. Ho-Oh's shrine then begins to glow. Eusine sees that Ho-Oh is still on its way and Crystal realizes that Suicune was attempting to meet Ho-Oh at the Tin Tower. Eusine then thanks Crystal for the two weeks they spent together and leaves on his {{p|Jumpluff}} to find Suicune. Crystal starts to cry because she realizes that Suicune was trying to meet Ho-Oh alone, that it tried to stop her from interfering via the Crystal Wall, and that she had hindered Suicune's mission. However, Crystal and Eusine both fail to realize that since the Crystal Wall is still active, it also means Suicune is still close by. Suicune senses Crystal's emotions and they both have a second of connection. She then picks herself up and attempts to catch a {{p|Psyduck}} which raises her spirits. At the [[Team Rocket HQ]], the [[Masked Man]] questions [[Sham]] and [[Carl]] about the status of their plot to capture Suicune. They explain that their Clear Bell has been stolen and that the capture of Suicune has been unsuccessful. The Masked Man, believing that Suicune will appear in front of the [[Gym Leader]]s, orders Sham and Carl to keep an eye on them. ==Major events== * {{adv|Crystal}} fails to capture {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}}, making it her first failed capture. * Crystal and [[Eusine]] find out that {{p|Ho-Oh}} is angry and will still return. * The [[Masked Man]] sends [[Sham]] and [[Carl]] to spy on the [[Gym Leader]]s. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Crystal}} * [[Eusine]] * [[Masked Man]] * [[Sham]] * [[Carl]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Arcanine}} ([[Archy]], {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Parasect}} (Parasee, {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Cubone}} ([[Bonee]]; {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Hitmonchan}} ([[Monlee]], {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Natu}} (Natee, {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Chikorita}} ([[Megaree]], {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Jumpluff}} ([[Eusine]]'s) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}; statue and silhouette) * {{p|Suicune}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune|Adventures}}) * {{p|Psyduck}} ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, there is a small spacing error on Page 38.
